findings.detail: Both days pooled: 145,667 subway and 2,809,939 bus inferred arrivals at intermediate stops.
findings.headline: 68.2 % of subway arrivals were on time, against 47.1 % of bus arrivals.

findings.detail: Hours of the service day (scheduled time) with at least 1,000 arrivals, both days pooled.
findings.headline: Bus punctuality was lowest at 16:00 (40.3 %) and highest at 00:00 (62.2 %).
Route QM42 ranked last of 345 bus routes: 19.9 % on time.

findings.detail: Precision 83 %, recall 75 %; rules were tuned on the other day only.
findings.headline: Halfway through a bus trip, a simple rule predicted a late finish with F1 0.79 against the baseline's 0.77 on a held-out day: passed.

hero.caption: 12,779 bus and subway stops in 1,502 cells of about 670 m, coloured by the share of their inferred arrivals that were on time, both days pooled. Grey: cells with fewer than 10 arrivals.

caveat.text: **Read the subway's trip figures with care.** 10.9 % of the subway's real-time trips on this day could not be matched to a scheduled trip (their IDs differ from the timetable). Some scheduled trips counted as never reported probably ran under such an ID.
